headline: DTCC plans to bring tokenized securities to Solana

scenes.vo: The company that settles most American stock trades just picked Solana. Here's what changed.
On Thursday, DTCC said it will connect its tokenization service to Solana, so eligible securities it holds can become tokens there. The target is the second half of twenty twenty seven.
Here's why traders are watching it. DTCC's depository held about one hundred fourteen trillion dollars in securities last year. Solana is the first public blockchain it has named.
The catch? This is a plan, not a live product. Nothing moves to Solana until late twenty twenty seven, and Solana's price fell with the market today.
Here's what happens next. Watch which banks sign up, which assets go first, and whether DTCC names more public blockchains.
